svg.title: kicker_left floor-rail notch and screw placement
svg.text: kicker_left — floor-rail clearance, dimensions in mm
Front view. Dimension from original rectangular panel edges; use numbers, not image scale.
Panel blank 1219.2 × 277; notch 40.1 wide × 141.7 high, open to bottom/outside edge.
Rail section 38.1 × 139.7; clearance 2 above and beside rail.
Outer post screws: world X = ±1162.05; Z = 60 and 192. All nine axes: panel-attachment-axes.csv.
Notch-edge clearance to lower outer screw axis: 17.05. Hold/LED drilling: panel-hole-axes.csv.
SPAX axes shown; occupied diameter does not specify a pilot. Do not bridge the independent center seam.
